note: Vision-guided IK sorter (hfteama sort ...). Table frame, seen from BEHIND the arms (facing the camera): origin at the centre of tag 1 (back-left), x to the right along the back tags (tag 2 at x = 0.734), y forward towards the camera (tags 3 and 0 at y = 0.335), z up; metres. Tag centres: 73.4 cm apart along x, 33.5 cm along y. See docs/hardware/sorter.md.

ignore.note: Never pieces: large dark colourless regions (black arm, wrist cameras, cables; Lab chroma < dark_chroma_max, so a dark blue piece still counts) and green ones (green arm), grown by 'grow' m. OpenCV hue 0..180, Lab L 0..255.

pieces.object_note: Current pieces: boxes 5.8 x 5.8 x 3.9 cm with a 3 cm tag on top and bottom.

tags.note: Each box has a DICT_4X4_50 tag (any id) of `size` m on its top (and bottom). A 4x4 tag much smaller than the reference tags is a box tag; its centre at object_height is the box centre. size = the black square as the camera measures it flat (2.9 cm); size_tol 4 %: a loose tag lying on the table measures ~5 % smaller at the box-top height, so it is not taken for a box.

arms_note: Arms are named after their pair. Seen from behind the arms: rakesh (black) on the right, hacklab (green) on the left. base = base_link origin in the table frame: 1.5 cm behind the back tags (y = -0.015), 16.3 cm in from the back tag on its side (measured); yaw_deg = heading of the arm's forward axis: +90 = facing the camera (+y).
arms_tuning_note: Per arm, measured with `hfteama sort jog`: z_offset = real tip height minus model (m); offsets_deg = ArmFrame joint zero offsets (rakesh's wrist_roll is 90 deg off the model); aim_offset = [forward, left] shift of the grasp point seen from behind the arm (m). aim_table = [[bearing_deg, forward, left, dz], ...]: the same shift as a function of where the piece is seen from the arm (0 = ahead, + = its left), interpolated; overrides aim_offset. bearing_range_deg = [min, max] bearing (deg, + = the arm's left) of the pieces this arm takes. aim_gain = 2x2 G: extra shift G @ (forward, left) of the piece from the base, proportional to where it is (about a 10 deg turn for rakesh). z_by_distance = [[r_m, dz_m], ...]: extra height by distance from the base (rakesh: 0.5 cm lower at 18 cm, nothing from 28 cm). x_range = [min, max] table x of the pieces this arm takes: its half of the table (split halfway between the bases). home = rest pose (LeRobot deg) the arm returns to; without it, the pose it had when the sorter connected.

hacklab.note: wrist_roll offset 0 (not rakesh's 90: its logged grasps fit the shared gripper geometry only with the jaws turned 90 deg). jaw offsets as rakesh. aim_offset / aim_gain fitted on its grasps.

motion.drop_shift_note: main's place over the bowl (bridge): the drop point may move this far from the asked point towards the arm, to keep the gripper down. 5 cm keeps a 5.8 cm box inside the 18 cm bowl.
motion.home_note: Home (camera-clear) pose = the pose the arm has when the sorter connects: leave each arm folded at rest before starting.
motion.wrist_roll_note: wrist_roll stays within (arm's wrist_roll_center_deg, LeRobot deg, default 0) +- this: the moving jaw always on the same side
